title: Plynth built materials, version 1
description: build/materials.json, written by the Blender build together with build/building.fbx. The FBX cannot carry metallic or opacity maps to the 3D preview, so the preview replaces the materials its FBX loader made with these: matched by material name, or by object name and slot order when the loader keeps no names. Furniture keeps the materials of its asset and is not listed. Paths are absolute, UTF-8, forward slashes. base_color is sRGB; the other maps are linear, grey maps are read from the red channel, normal is OpenGL. Every map is an image tiled by the mesh's UVs; nothing is a plain number.

name.description: The Blender and FBX material name: the catalog id, or the neutral surface name.

material.description: The catalog material id, or null for a neutral look.

surface.description: The neutral surface, or null for a catalog material.

alpha_mode.description: blend when there is an opacity map.

objects.description: Every built object except furniture, with the material name of each of its slots in order.

name.description: The Blender and FBX object name, for example SM_f1_Walls.
